subject: ours:control-loop
why: New model-invocable skill, owner rulings of 2026-11-22 (2026-11-22-rejects-review:059: design-control-loop adopted, adapted, as this skill) and 2026-11-24 (answers 1a, 2a and 3a on the control-loop proposal). It sets up a recurring, scheduled loop that drives one measured property of a codebase toward a target through one small pull request per run: read the repository, interview the owner part by part with grounded proposals, write the charter as the loop's feature bead, build the sensor, controller, actuator instructions, steering file and run script in a loop folder, run each by hand, one real dry run on the owner's go, and a local timer only when the owner asks (a CI runner named as a later option). State in Beads: each run a child task bead and one pull request with Refs, never Closes (the cr-cood loop exception), targets noted done, skipped or failed on the loop bead; one open pull request per loop; the agent runs with an explicit allowlist, a turn limit and a spend cap, never a bypass mode, and never stages, commits or pushes; the run script stages by name, runs the commit gate before the commit, pushes the run's branch and opens the pull request; never force-push, never merge, every other network write held; review comments are the babysit playbook's; /iterate dropped. References carry the run-script, actuator, steering and local-timer templates. Placement engineering · X · Coordination, secondary Maintenance, family agentic-control-loop, boundary against autonomous-run, hillclimb and autopilot-full. The first loop, Ruff findings to zero outside workflow_interpreter/, is in tools/loops/ruff-zero/.

The grant: per run, the task bead and its notes, a branch, the gated commit, an ordinary push and the pull request; never force-push, never merge, every other network write held; silencing the sensor's tool is gate loosening, so the actuator skips the target.

Actuator judgement in one instructions file in the loop folder rather than a repository-local skill; two outcomes (fixed, skipped) with no ignore entry; the memory file becomes the steering file, read after the controller; overlapping runs skip through a lock rather than cancel the one in progress.
